visual.general_description: Three box plots (A to C) of HIT-6 score, monthly headache days and monthly acute medication intake days at 0, 1 and 3 months, with a shared color legend.
visual.detailed_description: White background with panel A on the left and panels B and C stacked on the right, each inside a thin gray frame. A colour legend at the lower left shows a blue square labelled 0 month, an orange square labelled 1 month and a gray square labelled 3 month, in large bold text. Panel A is titled HIT-6 with tick labels 36 to 76; panels B and C are titled MHD and AMD, each with days/months printed above the axis and tick labels 0 to 30. Each panel shows three boxes (blue, orange, gray) with a median line, a cross marker, whiskers and small open circles for individual points. Asterisks are printed above the gray 3 month box in panels A and B only. In A and B the boxes step downward from 0 to 3 months; in C the boxes become smaller across the groups.

panels.general_description: Box plot of HIT-6 score at 0, 1 and 3 months, panel A.
panels.detailed_description: Panel (A) is titled HIT-6. The vertical axis has no printed label and shows tick labels 36 to 76 in steps of 5.  Three box-and-whisker boxes are drawn side by side: blue for 0 month, orange for 1 month and gray for 3 month, as named in the legend at the lower left of the figure. Each box carries a horizontal line inside it, a cross marker, whiskers and small open circles drawn along it (individual data points); no separate outlier markers are visible. The boxes step downward from the 0 month group to the 3 month group. The 1 month box has a long lower whisker. An asterisk is printed above the gray 3 month box.
